headline: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Thursday suggested that political parties hold a referendum on creating new administrative units or provinces, Dawn reports.
warnings: TikTok skipped: 6 TikTok posts on RiseUp day 2026-11-12; allowed by 21:00 = 6 (max 8/day)

feed.text:
Naye subay banane par referendum karwaya jaye: Mohsin Naqvi!
Dawn ke mutabiq Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi ne Thursday ko Lahore mein media se baat karte hue kaha ke siyasi jamaatein naye subon (provinces) par referendum, yaani awam ki raye se faisla, karwayein. Unhon ne kaha ke agar awam naye subon ke khilaf hai to woh "100 percent" awam ke saath hain, aur agar awam haq mein hai to naye subay banne chahiye. PPP Punjab ne naye subay banane ki sakht mukhalifat ki hai.
Kya Pakistan mein naye subay banne chahiye? Comment mein batayein 👇
